Automatically build and keep the local database index up to date (structure only) in the background for connected databases. Requires Auto Database Indexing (Sponsor).
Enable vector embeddings generation for tables and views to support semantic search grounding in AI tools.

settings.markdownDescription: Write verbose diagnostic logging to the **NexQL Debug** output channel. Off by default to keep SQL, schema, and AI payloads out of logs.

settings.description: Automatically format .pgsql / .sql files on save.
Indent style used by the SQL formatter.
Keyword case used by the SQL formatter.
Number of blank lines between SQL statements in the formatter output.
Number of spaces per indent level in the SQL formatter.
Use tabs instead of spaces for SQL formatter indentation.
Base URL for the NexQL license validation API.

enumDescriptions: No metering — all features unlimited for everyone (development / dark-ship).
Freemium: free tier gets daily/weekly per-feature allowances; paid tiers are unlimited (default).
settings.markdownDescription: Controls premium feature access. `freemium` (default) gives the free tier metered daily/weekly use of premium features and unlimited use to paid subscribers. `off` disables all metering. Legacy values `soft`/`hard` are treated as `freemium`.
Absolute path to a standalone `nexql-mcp` binary. Used as a fallback when Node.js/npx is not available. When empty, NexQL tries `NEXQL_MCP_BIN`, then PATH.

Expose NexQL's read-only database tools as an MCP server by spawning `nexql-mcp` via `npx -y nexql-mcp@latest` (stdio). VS Code Copilot and other MCP clients discover it via the extension registry. On by default.
Maximum number of rows returned by AI tool queries (`run_select`). Results beyond this limit are truncated and flagged. Applies to both NexQL Bot and MCP clients.
Tool surface exposed to the NexQL Bot MCP client. `full` (default) sends all tools; `meta` sends a small core set plus `discover_tools`; `query`/`dba` are intent-scoped subsets.

settings.description: Poll the OpenCode server and auto-approve any permission prompts during NexQL Bot requests.
Automatically start and reuse a local opencode serve instance for faster NexQL Bot requests.
Optional path to the OpenCode CLI binary. Auto-detected from PATH and common install locations when empty.
When the OpenCode CLI is not found, fall back to @opencode-ai/sdk if installed.
Fixed port for auto-started opencode serve (0 = pick a free port).
OpenCode server URL (opencode serve). Auto-populated when opencodeAutoServe starts a managed server.
Show the OpenCode output channel while requests are running (View → Output → OpenCode).
Auto-allow OpenCode tool permissions for headless NexQL Bot runs (YOLO mode). Required when attaching to opencode serve.
Working directory for OpenCode serve/run. Defaults to the VS Code workspace folder, or ~/.nexql/opencode-wd when the host folder is an IDE install path.
Remember the last entered SQL parameter values in this workspace.
Exact input text that is sent as SQL NULL for prompted parameters. Set empty string to disable.
Default row limit for SELECT queries when auto-LIMIT is enabled.
Maximum rows kept in the result grid at once when sliding-window streaming is active.
Use a PostgreSQL SCROLL cursor for eligible SELECT queries (no SQL parameters): stream one window of rows into the cell and fetch more on scroll—bounded RAM on host and webview.
Threshold in milliseconds to flag slow queries in history and results.
Automatically append LIMIT clause to SELECT queries that don't have one. Always enabled in read-only mode.
Display format for binary (bytea) columns in query results: 0x-prefixed hex, PostgreSQL \x hex, or JSON Buffer shape (debug).
Default SQL workspace when opening Query Tool (notebook or Query Studio).
Strategy when a statement fails in multi-statement execution: 'continue-on-error' (execute remaining, show summary), 'fail-on-error' (stop immediately), 'prompt-on-error' (ask user per failure).
Maximum number of query history entries to retain. Older entries are removed once the limit is reached.
Global query timeout in milliseconds (0 for no timeout). Can be overridden per connection.
Show environment chip in the NexQL Bot context bar.
Tint workbench title bar, activity bar, and status bar chrome by environment.
Enable Sentinel environment signaling when a tagged .pgsql notebook is focused.
Show in-notebook connection context strip with environment chip.
Show a notification when the active notebook environment changes (e.g. staging → production).
Tint status bar connection items by environment (production, staging, development).
Show [P]/[S]/[D] badges on open .pgsql notebook tabs for tagged connections.
Advanced: suggest or auto-switch the entire color theme by environment.
How theme swap behaves when themeSwap.enabled is true.
Map of environment (production, staging, development) to color theme label.
Base URL for NexQL account and cloud sync API.
Enable automatic sync (pull on activation, debounced push, periodic pull).
Folder for synced .pgsql notebooks (supports ~ for home directory).
Connection ID for optional team Postgres sync backend (nexql_sync schema).
Interval in minutes for periodic sync pulls.
Allow anonymized performance telemetry (duration/result-size buckets).
Allow anonymous usage telemetry (commands/features/session counters).
Telemetry flush interval in milliseconds.
Maximum number of events per telemetry batch.
Telemetry collection mode. off disables telemetry. basic sends anonymous usage counters. detailed adds anonymized performance buckets.
PostHog project API key. Keep empty to disable remote telemetry sink.
PostHog ingestion host used for telemetry transport.
